_doc: Interface and ownership registry for docs/harness/rebuild/. Convention: redesign/INTERFACES.md. harness.design rejects unknown keys, so this metadata cannot live in the .harness files.
_scope: The center cluster's own assembly harness is owned by center-cluster-esp32-p4 and is not drawn here; ST185-CAN ends at its CAN-drop terminal t_cluster_can. The cluster warning-LED loom (ST185-ClusterLED) is owned here.

A-ECU.physical: ECU/cabin harness - ECU-A and ECU-B connectors, cabin halves of bulkheads A and B, CSB3 plug, wheel-speed spurs

B-ECU.physical: ECU/cabin harness - power side: relays, fuse box, shared +5V / Gnd Out / chassis splices

A-engine.physical: Engine harness - signal circuits behind bulkheads A and B

B-engine.physical: Engine harness - power circuits behind bulkheads A and B

WheelSpeed.physical: Wheel speed, front and rear (being split into WheelSpeed-Front / WheelSpeed-Rear)

realConnectors.note: HD36-24-33SE plug mating the CSB3 enclosure's HD34-24-33PE. The harness stops here; CSB3 itself is not drawn.
Dummy header crimped and plugged into J/B2 2A (ENGINE-ROOM-POWER-REDISTRIBUTION.md section 5.4). Plugs in, so it is a connector, not a flying lead.
